intro.h2: A Poway showroom where your kitchen gets planned first
paragraphs: Kitchen Barn offers kitchen remodeling in Poway and across San Diego County as a family-owned, design-build company. You sit down with the team at the showroom on Danielson Street, choose cabinets and finishes in person, and see the layout before any work starts. Then the same company manages the build, so you keep one point of contact.

The firm also handles bathrooms and whole-home projects, and it runs an Express Kitchen and Bath track for owners on a tight schedule. Reviewers name David, Kyle and Angel, and they mention design help that showed them how each option would look. The site says much of the firm's work comes from referrals.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Poway, plus baths and whole homes

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Restore the kitchen you have, update it with new fixtures and finishes, or redesign the whole layout. The team plans cabinets, storage and flow with you, using cabinet lines that carry product warranties, then builds it under one design-build contract.

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Bathrooms get the same restore, update or redesign choice. Designers and installers work together on vanity storage, layout and finishes. One recent client said David, Kyle and Angel were kind, respectful and diligent, and that the new bathroom looks great.

image.alt: Bathroom remodel with a gray shaker double vanity, white quartz top and black-framed mirrors

items.name: Whole Home Remodeling
items.blurb: For projects that touch several rooms, Kitchen Barn plans the house as one design. A recent client had the kitchen, family room and guest bath done together. The firm's September 2026 blog post explains how San Diego owners can split a whole-home remodel into phases.

items.blurb: Built for owners on a deadline. The site lists about one week for the home consultation, one week of design at the showroom, two to three weeks for expedited cabinets to arrive, and about one week of installation. You still choose from the full range of fixtures and hardware.

why_choose_us.h2: Why San Diego County homeowners call Kitchen Barn

items.title: A showroom you can walk into
items.text: Design review and sign-off happen at the Poway showroom, so you see cabinet lines, countertops, moldings and flooring before you commit. The team lists certified expertise in 2020 Design Studio.

items.title: Father and son, hands on
items.text: Mathew and David Taft founded the company. Reviewers mention David and Matt by name for design ideas, clear communication and returning calls on time.

items.title: Members, licensed and insured
items.text: Kitchen Barn states it is fully licensed and insured. It belongs to the National Kitchen and Bath Association, the Poway Chamber of Commerce and the BBB.

items.title: Work that comes from referrals
items.text: The company says much of its work comes from past clients. Its Google profile shows 5.0 stars from 14 reviews, and reviewers often describe the team as friendly, responsive and thoughtful.

about.text: Kitchen Barn was founded by Mathew Taft and David Taft, a father-and-son team. In their words, the business blends seasoned expertise with youthful innovation. The About page says they have served the community for 15 years, and the home page notes over 30 years of remodeling experience. The firm works from a showroom at 13771 Danielson St in Poway, where clients review designs and choose cabinets, counters and hardware. David is the name most reviewers mention: he helps with layouts, returns calls, and once came right away to fix a client's broken sliding shelf.

process.h2: The Express Kitchen and Bath timeline

steps.title: Home consultation (about 1 week)
steps.text: The team visits your home to learn what you need from the room, how you use it and the style you like.

steps.title: Showroom design review (about 1 week)
steps.text: You come to the Poway showroom once or twice to review the layout and pick cabinets, counters, moldings, flooring and hardware, then sign off.

steps.title: Order materials (2 to 3 weeks)
steps.text: Cabinets from the expedited lines are delivered in two to three weeks. Installation is scheduled to start once everything arrives.

steps.title: Install (about 1 week)
steps.text: The crew completes the kitchen or bath on the shorter timeline, with the same attention to detail as a standard remodel.

service_area.h2: Serving Poway and San Diego County
service_area.text: Kitchen Barn is based in Poway and works with homeowners throughout San Diego County. Design reviews happen at the showroom on Danielson Street, so most clients visit at least once. One project named on the site is a full new-build home in Ramona, with kitchen, bath, laundry room and built-in cabinets by the fireplace. The site does not publish a full town list, so call to confirm your area.

faq.h2: Questions Poway homeowners ask Kitchen Barn

items.a: Yes. The kitchen and whole-home pages invite you to contact Kitchen Barn for a free consultation, and the bathroom page calls it a complimentary consultation. Call (888) 454-6465 to make an appointment. The team talks through your goals first, then plans the design with you at the Poway showroom.

items.q: How fast can an express kitchen or bath be finished?
items.a: The Express Kitchen and Bath page lists about one week for the home consultation, one week of showroom design, two to three weeks for expedited cabinets to arrive and about one week to install. By those phases, an express project runs roughly five to six weeks, depending on the cabinet line you choose.

items.q: What warranty comes with the work?
items.a: The home page says Kitchen Barn's cabinet lines carry product warranties for customers. The site does not spell out a separate written warranty on labor, so ask for those terms in writing when you review your proposal. That way you know what each part of the project covers.

items.q: Can I see cabinets and finishes before I decide?
items.a: Yes. Design review and sign-off take place at the showroom at 13771 Danielson St in Poway. You compare cabinet lines, countertops, moldings, flooring, fixtures and hardware in person. Reviewers say the team showed them how different options would look, which made each choice easier.

items.q: Do you remodel more than kitchens?
items.a: Yes. Despite the name, the firm handles bathrooms, laundry rooms, family rooms and whole-home remodels. One client had the kitchen, family room and guest bath done together, and another had cabinets built for a full new home in Ramona. The firm's blog also covers doing a whole-home remodel in phases.

final_cta.h2: Plan your kitchen at the Poway showroom
final_cta.text: Call (888) 454-6465 to make an appointment, or send a short note and the team will get back to you about a free consultation.

current_site_defects: Measured: Google PageSpeed mobile performance score 51 on the home page.

The home page hero is a self-hosted video (kitchen-barn-hero.mp4); the crawl captured 'Media error: Format(s) not supported or source(s) not found' where it should play, so some visitors see an error instead of a kitchen.
The H1 reads 'Your Partners in Quality Home Remodeling' with no service or city in it; 'San Diego' only appears in an H2.
Every email link points to 'mailto:Info@kitchenbarn.net%C2%A0', with a hidden non-breaking space after the address that can break the link.
No list of towns served anywhere on the pages crawled, only 'San Diego County'; Poway, where the showroom is, never appears in a heading.
The review widget says 'Based on 16 reviews' while the Google profile shows 14, and the widget's dates ('2 days ago') are relative and stale.
The About page says 15 years serving the community and the home page says over 30 years of experience, with no explanation, which can read as a contradiction.
Footer copyright still reads 2024, and the kitchen page CTA heading reads 'Restore Your Kitchens Beauty?' with a missing apostrophe.
what_this_homepage_fixes: Puts the Poway showroom and the primary keyword in the title, H1 and hero alt text, and lists the towns the firm actually names.
Replaces the failing hero video with one of the firm's own kitchen photos, which loads fast on phones.
Shows the tap-to-call (888) 454-6465 at top and bottom and offers the free consultation the site already promises.
Moves the Express Kitchen and Bath timeline onto the home page as a clear differentiator.
Uses three real Google reviews with names and dates and states the 5.0 rating and 14-review count accurately.
Explains the 15-year and 30-year figures in plain words in the About section instead of leaving them to conflict.

conversion_notes.outreach_hook: Your Express Kitchen and Bath page promises a finished room in about five to six weeks, but the home page scores 51 on mobile and its hero video shows a media error, so many phone visitors never reach that offer.
